dedupe_keys.name: absice agent based simulations of the circular economy python mesa agent based model of end of life decisions and waste in industrial symbiosis networks

description: ABSiCE, short for Agent-Based Simulations of the Circular Economy, is an agent-based model written in Python with the Mesa library for studying strategies to keep products and materials in use. The repository was created in 2019 on GitLab under the account juwal, and a 2023 fork describes it as a tool developed at the US National Renewable Energy Laboratory. Actors are connected in a configurable network drawn from the industrial symbiosis literature; products grow in number and generate waste, and each agent applies an end-of-life decision rule, such as reuse, recycling or disposal, so that the model shows how waste and recovered material flow under different strategies. The code is free to download from GitLab and needs Mesa and networkx. Caveats: the README is short, no licence file is detected, the last activity was in 2020, and the NREL attribution comes from the fork's description, not from the original repository. Coverage is general. Simulation uses: exploring how take-back, recycling and landfill choices change waste volumes reaching treatment facilities. Related records: the circular business model biodigestion network (model-comses-circular-business-model-biodigestion-network) is a related agent-based model of waste reuse networks.
